reuse.why: Extends the existing getFillableCategories selection and uses the shared extractTagsFromText tag parser instead of a hand-written match.

duplication.why: The rule is added once in the shared selection; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The exclusion lives in budget/actions.ts next to the hidden and template rules, in the function every month-wide action already uses.

scope.why: Only the selection query/filter and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Small, commented change to the single selection point; a maintainer can read all exclusion rules in one place.

one_place.where: getFillableCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by all month-wide actions
